title: Bounce
about: A ball bouncing off the screen edges and a paddle the joystick moves. Keys: O P or the arrows move the paddle.

title: Breakout
about: Bricks, bat and ball with text, tiles, collision and sound. Keys: O P or the arrows; fire (Space) serves.

title: Shooter
about: A vertical shooter with pools of sprites, a scrolling-look sky map and sound. Keys: Q A O P or the arrows move; Space fires.

title: Leap Runner (platformer)
about: A scrolling platformer: a 128-cell level with three parallax bands, a 16x24 hero with animation, enemies, coins and a goal. Keys: O P move, Q or Space jump, A drops through planks.

title: Blockfall
about: A falling-blocks puzzle: tiles and text only, no sprites. Keys: O P left / right, Q rotate, A soft drop, Space hard drop, H pause.
